_notes: from_address `noreply@sector7g.io` is fictional. Replace with a sender you own/verify (Resend, Mailgun, SES) before sending.
from_name is what most email clients display prominently — the actual address is hidden behind it in most inboxes.
When you wire delivery via Resend/Edge Function, set the From header literally as: From: Sector 7-G Operations <noreply@your-real-domain>
reply_to=null prevents the user from replying — clients show 'No reply' or just suppress the reply button.
